security_audit.summary: The two external command findings are false positives from Markdown formatting, not executable code. The skill intentionally fetches public guidelines from a GitHub Raw URL and follows remote guideline instructions, which leaves a low network and remote-content risk. No evidence found of prompt injection, data exfiltration, or malicious intent.

remediation.issue: External network fetch to mutable guideline content
remediation.suggestion: Pin the guideline URL to an immutable commit or vendor the guidelines with the skill package.

remediation.issue: Fetched content can influence output instructions
remediation.suggestion: Treat fetched guidelines as reference material and keep authority boundaries in the local skill instructions.

content.user_title: Audit Web UI Against Design Guidelines
content.value_statement: Interface reviews often miss accessibility and consistency issues. This skill checks selected web files against current design guidelines and reports concise file-level findings.
actual_capabilities: Fetches the latest Web Interface Guidelines from the configured public source.
Reviews user-specified files or file patterns for guideline compliance.
Checks interface code for accessibility, usability, and visual consistency issues.
Reports findings in concise file and line format for quick triage.
Asks which files to review when no target files are provided.
limitations: Requires network access to fetch the latest guideline source.
Does not run browser-based accessibility tests or visual regression tests.
Review quality depends on the files and patterns supplied by the user.
Remote guideline changes can affect future review output.

use_cases.title: Pre-merge UI Review
use_cases.description: Review changed frontend files before merging a pull request.

use_cases.title: Accessibility Pass
use_cases.description: Check interface components for accessibility and usability concerns before release.

use_cases.title: Design Consistency Audit
use_cases.description: Find inconsistent interface patterns across screens during a design system cleanup.

prompt_templates.title: Review One File
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single component file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review src/components/Header.tsx with web-design-guidelines. Report only guideline issues with file and line references.

prompt_templates.title: Review A Feature Folder
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused review of a new UI feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use web-design-guidelines to audit src/features/checkout. Focus on accessibility, form behavior, and visual consistency.

prompt_templates.title: Review Changed Files
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the changed frontend files with web-design-guidelines. Prioritize issues that affect users or block release quality.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Against System Standards
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced audit for a mature product interface.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use web-design-guidelines on the dashboard UI. Group findings by severity and note repeated design system violations.

output_examples.input: Review a navigation component before merge.
output_examples.output: Findings list with file and line references for focus states, landmark usage, and menu behavior.

output_examples.input: Audit a checkout flow folder for accessibility problems.
output_examples.output: Concise report covering labels, error states, keyboard flow, and layout consistency.

output_examples.input: Check a dashboard against web interface rules.
output_examples.output: Grouped issues that identify inconsistent spacing, unclear actions, and missing accessible names.

best_practices: Provide the exact files or folders that contain the interface under review.
Run the review before merge so findings can be fixed with the related change.
Pair the findings with manual browser checks for interactive behavior.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a full repository audit when only one screen changed.
Do not treat guideline findings as a substitute for automated accessibility testing.
Do not ignore network requirements in restricted or offline environments.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews web interface files against published Web Interface Guidelines.

faq.question: Does it need internet access?
faq.answer: Yes. It fetches the latest guideline content from a configured GitHub Raw URL.

faq.question: Can it review a whole project?
faq.answer: It can review supplied file patterns, but focused paths usually produce clearer findings.

faq.question: Does it run automated tests?
faq.answer: No. It performs guideline review and does not run browser, unit, or accessibility test suites.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What output should I expect?
faq.answer: Expect concise findings with file and line references for issues that match the guidelines.
